solver: OpenFOAM v2512 post-hoc: <solver> -postProcess -funcs '(yPlus wallShearStress)' -time T, on copies in ~/wind_tunnel/_step3

definitions.yplus: OpenFOAM yPlus FO; on nutUSpaldingWallFunction patches y calcUTau(|snGrad U|)/nu with y = nearWallDist (src/functionObjects/field/yPlus/yPlus.C:136-157; nutUSpaldingWallFunctionFvPatchScalarField.C:322-343)
definitions.d_m: normal distance owner cell centre (mean of face centres) to the body face plane, our estimate of nearWallDist
definitions.u_tau: yplus nu / d; cross-checked against sqrt(|wallShearStress|): median ratio 1.000 to 1.012 on all four, so d matches nearWallDist
definitions.table: every first cell centre moved to a common distance y, u_tau per face UNCHANGED (assumption: u_tau is set by the outer flow; it ignores any shift in separation and the Spalding u_tau change with y)

correction_to_prompt_facts: _t1/Cube/0 is NOT a converged steady field: the T1 Allrun copied the uniform 0.orig and ran potentialFoam -writep, so processor*/0 is potential U, p with uniform k, omega, nut. No converged steady cube field is left on disk (_anim deleted). The T1 field at t = 2 s is used instead.
case.Setup.first_cell returns y/L (2D case: chord 1, U 1, nu = 1/Re). For L = 2 m, U = 20 m/s and y+ 50 the flat-plate estimate is a centre distance of 0.95 mm (u_tau 0.79 m/s), not 4.73e-4 m.
